name: FoodOrd
author: foodord

sections.description:
FoodOrd is a comprehensive food ordering plugin designed specifically for WooCommerce. It transforms your WordPress website into a complete online food ordering system with delivery and pickup options.

🔴 Click Here to Launch Live Demo

🖥️ Native Desktop Application with Thermal Printing

FoodOrd comes with a powerful Desktop Application (Windows & Mac) that turns your computer into a professional order terminal.

  • 🖨️ Auto-Print Receipts: Connect your thermal printer (USB/LAN) and print orders automatically the moment they arrive. (Pro)
  • 🔔 Real-Time Notifications: Never miss an order with loud sound alerts and visual popups on your desktop. (Pro)
  • ⚡ Instant Order Management: Accept or reject orders with a single click without refreshing any page. (Pro)
  • 🚀 Point of Sale: Integrated POS native application. (Pro)

⭐ Unlock More with FoodOrd PRO

Take your restaurant sales to the next level with our Premium features.

👉 Get FoodOrd PRO & Desktop App

  • 🏆 Loyalty Points System: Reward your regular customers. Let them earn points with every order and redeem them for discounts.
  • 💸 Advanced Pricing Rules: Create powerful campaigns like “Buy 1 Get 1 Free (BOGO)”, “20% Off on Tuesdays”, or “Free Drink with Orders over $50”.
  • 💰 Tipping at Checkout: Allow happy customers to leave a tip for your riders directly at checkout.

Key Features

  • Dual Order Modes – Support for both delivery and pickup orders
  • Advanced Topping System – Create unlimited toppings, groups, and sets for customizable products
  • Business Hours Management – Set opening hours and automatically handle closed periods
  • Location Service – Delivery area management with distance calculations
  • Mobile-Optimized Cart – Responsive cart interface for mobile users
  • AJAX Add to Cart – Smooth, fast product additions without page reloads
  • Product Modal System – Beautiful product detail popups
  • Checkout Validation – Smart validation for delivery/pickup requirements
  • Gutenberg Blocks – Native WordPress block editor support
  • Shortcodes – Easy content integration with shortcodes

Perfect For

  • Restaurants
  • Cafes
  • Fast Food Chains
  • Food Trucks
  • Bakeries
  • Cloud Kitchens
  • Ghost Kitchens

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher

Documentation & Support

  • Documentation
  • Support Forum

External services

This plugin can connect to external services (optional):

Google Maps Platform (Maps JavaScript API / Places & Geocoding)

Used for address autocomplete and radius-based delivery zones when you enable radius delivery mode and provide a Google Maps API key.

  • Service: https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js (Maps JavaScript API / Places)
  • Service: https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json (Geocoding API)
  • Data sent: API key; store address (for geocoding); address query/selection (for autocomplete)
  • Terms: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

FoodOrd license verification (optional)

Used only when you enter a license key for the optional desktop application.

  • Service: https://foodord.com/wp-json/foodord-cloud/v1/license/verify
  • Data sent: license key/purchase code, site URL/domain
  • Terms: https://www.foodord.com/terms-and-conditions/
  • Privacy: https://www.foodord.com/privacy-policy/

Privacy Policy

Data Collection

FoodOrd itself does not collect or store any personal data beyond what WordPress and WooCommerce already collect. All customer data is managed through WooCommerce’s standard privacy tools.

Desktop Application Integration

When the optional desktop application is connected:

  • Order data, customer names, and addresses are accessible via REST API
  • Data is only shared when desktop app is actively connected
  • Users can disconnect the desktop app anytime from plugin settings
  • All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS
  • Desktop app requires WordPress user authentication

License Validation

When activating a license key for desktop app:

  • Purchase code, site domain, and site URL are sent to our license validation service
  • This data is used solely for license validation
  • No customer or order data is transmitted during license validation
  • License validation is optional and not required for plugin functionality

For complete privacy information, visit: https://www.foodord.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “FoodOrd”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

After Activation

  1. Go to FoodOrd > Settings in your WordPress admin
  2. Configure your delivery and pickup options
  3. Set up your business hours
  4. Create topping groups and items (optional)
  5. Start adding products with custom toppings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No, FoodOrd requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Can I use this with any WordPress theme?

Yes, but it works best with the FoodOrd Theme. Some features may require custom styling with other themes.

How do I set up delivery areas?

Navigate to FoodOrd > Delivery Settings in your WordPress admin. You can configure delivery zones, fees, and minimum order amounts.

Can customers choose between delivery and pickup?

Yes! Customers can switch between delivery and pickup modes before checkout.

How do toppings work?

Create topping groups (e.g., “Pizza Toppings”), add items to groups (e.g., “Extra Cheese”), then assign groups to products. Customers can customize their orders during the ordering process.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes! FoodOrd is translation-ready. Use the included .pot file with tools like Poedit or Loco Translate.

Does it support payment gateways?

FoodOrd uses WooCommerce’s payment system, so all WooCommerce payment gateways are supported.

How do I integrate with the desktop application?

The desktop application is optional. If you want to use it, navigate to FoodOrd > License to activate your desktop application license. The plugin works fully without the desktop app.
